cases.input: An internal need with scope, quantity, owner and budget reference is approved.
cases.expect: The request may initiate sourcing but creates no supplier, contract or order fact.

cases.input: One approved request is fulfilled through two independently issued orders.
cases.expect: The request retains one identity and references both orders without merging them.

cases.input: A request is withdrawn after review but before sourcing.
cases.expect: Its revisions and approval history remain resolvable.

cases.input: Internal request approval is treated as supplier award.
A budget reference is treated as committed and available funding.
The approved request is issued to a supplier as a purchase order.
